text: This report recommends that City Council authorize a correction to the by-law respecting the permanent closure of portions of Dundas Street West, Kipling Avenue and Bloor Street West in the Six Points area. City Council previously adopted Etobicoke York Community Council item EY24.19 at its meeting of June 8 and 9, 2021, authorizing the permanent closure of portions of Dundas Street West, Kipling Avenue and Bloor Street West. By-law 503-2021 was subsequently enacted; however, the by-law was not registered on title. Following further review, it was determined that the legal descriptions contained in the enacted by-law require a revision before registration can proceed. In particular, Part 4 on Plan 66R-31942 was included in the prior by-law description in error and is not included in the revised legal descriptions recommended through this report. City Council authorize the permanent closure of the portions of the public highways known as Dundas Street West, Kipling Avenue and Bloor Street West, legally described in Attachment 1 to the report (June 18, 2026) from the Acting Deputy General Manager, Transportation Services. 2.
